name: Landbench 1.0
description: A dataset and set of evaluation metrics for data-driven prediction of land surface variables (remote‑sensing based Earth surface modeling).
reputation: Used within remote-sensing and land-surface modeling research communities but not as widely adopted as major general-purpose benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on per-pixel/temporal prediction of land-surface variables; risk of spatio-temporal leakage and dataset-specific biases; evaluation depends strongly on variable and lead time.
